Welcome!

Before you log in and start posting, important information and basic rules:

  • Advanced difficulty: You should know how to use a PC, how to stay safe on the internet and how to navigate a classic bulletin board forum.
  • Remember the passwords for downloads: "cs.rin.ru" and "csrin.org".
  • Know the basics: Before posting, read the forum rules, FAQ and other announcements.
  • Do your own research: Before posting, search existing posts on the first page and the last few pages of relevant topics (games, emulators, tools).
  • Do not spam: Keep your posts on topic and solution-oriented, avoid small talk and do not repeat requests.
  • Be safe: Download from trusted uploaders, report suspicious files to the staff team, use an ad blocker on all filesharing sites.
  • .. but not paranoid: Malware in game files is uncommon. Antivirus software reports many false positives in pirated software. Don't accuse members of spreading malware based on AV detections.
  • You shall not pass: Posts from new users are queued for manual review by moderators before they show up. This may take up to a few days. Be patient and do not try to submit your post multiple times.
  • Clean and efficient: We often reject or delete posts that are off topic or redundant, ignore one of these basic rules, violate one of our other forum rules, contain questions that are too vague or have already been answered, and so on. If your post is rejected, you get a notification by e-mail.
  • It's not personal: We review dozens or even hundreds of posts per day. Unfortunately we have to be very strict or game topics become too big. Please don't take a post disapproval personally and keep a copy of your post until it has been reviewed.

IMPORTANT: Following these basic rules helps keep this huge forum manageable for the staff team. Please do your part.

By clicking on "Login", you confirm that you have read and understood these rules and that you will follow them.
